faq.question: Can I attend a free demo class?
faq.answer: Yes, where offered. Submit the demo form with your course and preferred slot; the academy will confirm available sessions.

faq.question: Do you offer both online and classroom batches?
faq.answer: Where enabled by the institute, yes. The batch section shows the mode configured for each sample batch.

faq.question: How are fees structured?
faq.answer: Fee cards are sample starting prices. Update the actual tuition fee, registration charges, discounts, taxes and payment schedule in Admin before publishing.

faq.question: Are batch seats guaranteed after enquiry?
faq.answer: No. The seat counter is a planning display. Final seat availability requires confirmation from the institute.

faq.question: Can parents request progress updates?
faq.answer: Where offered, the institute can configure its actual parent-update process and communication schedule.
